def make_anti_sudoku(sudoku):
    rows = [set() for _ in range(9)]
    cols = [set() for _ in range(9)]
    blocks = [[set() for _ in range(3)] for _ in range(3)]

    for i in range(9):
        for j in range(9):
            num = int(sudoku[i][j])
            if num in rows[i] or num in cols[j] or num in blocks[i // 3][j // 3]:
                continue
            rows[i].add(num)
            cols[j].add(num)
            blocks[i // 3][j // 3].add(num)
            return sudoku[:i*9 + j] + str(9 - num % 9 if num % 9 != 0 else 9) + sudoku[i*9 + j+1:]
    return None

def solve(t, sudokus):
    results = []
    for sudoku in sudokus:
        result = make_anti_sudoku(sudoku)
        results.append(result)
    return results
